einzeiler: Mannequins are a 5-billion-dollar global industry driving retail sales.
kurzfassung: Mannequins are a powerful tool for retailers, boosting sales of displayed outfits significantly. The global industry relies on customized sculpting, modern materials, and efficient manufacturing processes. Unwanted figures often find a second life through specialized recycling and upcycling businesses.
stichpunkte: Mannequins drive retail sales by inspiring customers to buy entire outfits directly off the display.
The mannequin industry evolved from 19th-century tailor dress forms into a 5-billion-dollar global market.
Fusion Specialties manufactures thousands of custom and standard figures annually for major mainstream brands.
Modern manufacturing techniques allow companies to create dynamic poses and produce a mannequin every 18 minutes.
Retailers frequently update their displays, leading to a high turnover of figures every three to five years.
Companies like Mannequin Madness recycle and resell millions of discarded figures to small retailers, artists, and hobbyists.
Disposal methods for old mannequins range from material recycling and incineration for energy to finding new life as planters or tables.

clips.hook: Who styled early department store windows?
clips.text: In the earlier days of department stores, establishments employed specialized personnel responsible for dressing figures, styling hair, and arranging makeup.

clips.hook: How much does a commercial mannequin cost?
clips.text: Prices for commercial display figures vary between 450 and 1,300 dollars, depending on the complexity of production and level of detail.

clips.hook: How fast can you make a plastic salesperson?
clips.text: After tooling a prototype for mass production in Mexico, a manufacturing facility can turn out a new display figure approximately every 18 minutes.

clips.hook: Millions of figures passed through her hands.
clips.text: Operating a business focused on used display figures involves handling millions of items over a span of 25 years.

clips.hook: Some people save whales, she saves mannequins.
clips.text: While environmentalists focus on wildlife conservation, rescue efforts for retail display figures remain a personal passion.
